svg.title: Lourdu Raju
svg.desc: Agent profile: Lourdu Raju, machine learning engineer at Sujanix, Bengaluru, open to ML roles. Computer vision, GPU inference, MLOps. Abilities: detect (YOLO OBB, dials), read (SVTRv2 + CTC), accelerate (9x faster p50). Ultimate: 40M readings in production, live accuracy from 79% to 91%. A terminal line types: make vision models fast, honest and boring to run; pytorch to onnx to tensorrt to triton to production; measure first, ship second, talk last.
